title: Seeds of Faith
description: Priestess Elara wants an offering laid at Gaela's shrine in Elder Moor - fresh produce or flowers, nothing grand. But she sends you by way of Millbrook first, to a farmer named Edda whose spring planting came up thin. Elara says prayers don't feed anyone, and a priestess who hasn't stood in a bare larder has no business asking for one more offering from it.

objectives.description: Gather fresh produce or flowers (Wildflowers, Cabbage, or Wheat)
Place the offering at Gaela's shrine in Elder Moor
Hear from Edda what a thin planting actually costs a household
Return to Priestess Elara in Dalhurst

notes: Threat: Edda's household, first of a three-quest arc (01-02-03) following her farm through a bad season. Giver motive: Elara routes offering-bearers through a real farmer's kitchen on purpose - devotion that never sees hunger is cheap. Consequence: not wired; the household's situation carries forward in prose through gaela_02 and gaela_03.
